The bug in TestEscapedURLParams was that the expected identifier string used double percent escapes (%2f) instead of single percent escapes (%3a and %2f). The test compared against "http:%2f%2fexample.com%2fimage.png", but URLParam returns an unescaped version (e.g., "http%3a%2f%2fexample.com%2fimage.png"). Fixing the expected value to use single escapes resolves the failure.
